mapper.select: select application_id, user_id, real_name, gender, class_name, first_choice, second_choice, photo_url, apply_status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from qt_interview_application where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into qt_interview_application (user_id, real_name, gender, class_name, first_choice, second_choice, photo_url, apply_status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{className}, #{firstChoice}, #{secondChoice}, #{photoUrl}, #{applyStatus}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update qt_interview_application set real_name = #{realName}, gender = #{gender}, class_name = #{className}, first_choice = #{firstChoice}, second_choice = #{secondChoice}, photo_url = #{photoUrl}, apply_status = #{applyStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.select: select profile_id, user_id, application_id, self_intro, coding_experience, coding_experience_desc, quanta_understanding, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from qt_interview_profile where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into qt_interview_profile (user_id, application_id, self_intro, coding_experience, coding_experience_desc, quanta_understanding, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{applicationId}, #{selfIntro}, #{codingExperience}, #{codingExperienceDesc}, #{quantaUnderstanding}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update qt_interview_profile set application_id = #{applicationId}, self_intro = #{selfIntro}, coding_experience = #{codingExperience}, coding_experience_desc = #{codingExperienceDesc}, quanta_understanding = #{quantaUnderstanding}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where profile_id = #{profileId}
mapper.select: select r.result_id, r.application_id, r.user_id, r.round_id, rd.round_name, r.department, r.result_status, r.score, r.feedback, r.interview_time, r.published_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from qt_interview_result r left join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.user_id = #{userId} order by rd.round_no asc, r.create_time asc

select r.result_id, r.application_id, r.user_id, r.round_id, rd.round_name, r.department, r.result_status, r.score, r.feedback, r.interview_time, r.published_time, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time from qt_interview_result r left join qt_interview_round rd on r.round_id = rd.round_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.round_id = #{roundId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into qt_interview_result (application_id, user_id, round_id, department, result_status, score, feedback, interview_time, published_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{applicationId}, #{userId}, #{roundId}, #{department}, #{resultStatus}, #{score}, #{feedback}, #{interviewTime}, #{publishedTime}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now())
mapper.update: update qt_interview_result set department = #{department}, result_status = #{resultStatus}, score = #{score}, feedback = #{feedback}, interview_time = #{interviewTime}, published_time = #{publishedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where result_id = #{resultId}
